property_summary: For any admissible call to the fallback function, the reference contract transfers its entire balance to the caller exactly when block.number is a multiple of 15; the buggy contract instead transfers the balance exactly when block.number is not a multiple of 15.
change_summary: Change the transfer condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, inverting when the balance is sent.
